position_mapping_note: Only exact single-bit numeric matches to the bundle's native tactic-position catalog are labelled. GK is the only match-history position named by the upstream fmsave reference; other labels are candidates, not UI-verified match-position semantics. Raw position_code is preserved.
role_code_note: role_code is retained as a raw byte. Upstream fmsave documents its meaning as unestablished; it is not decoded by array order or by candidate roles.
rating_note: Ratings are sourced from the detailed raw match-report record at raw-window offset +136 (uint16 little-endian hundredths, divided by 100 and rounded half-up to one decimal) only when the current save passes at least 25 exact named-history rating cross-checks with zero mismatches. Otherwise retained same-match history remains the fallback; no performance-based estimate is used.
